exclusion.rule: Only a metric occurrence governed by an explicit framework-exclusion predicate is exempt. Each occurrence and candidate field is inspected independently. Ambiguity fails closed; exclusions never legalize typed industrial evidence or actual application elsewhere.
exclusion.unsupported_grammar: Not a general NLP classifier: unrecognized negation, double negative, conditional and mixed clauses do not receive exemption.

leverage.debt_cash_independence: CONTEXT_DEPENDENT; here components of one financial-resilience dimension, not two independent negative confirmations merely because there are two refs.
leverage.historical_comparison: Prior Sol SELL/WEAKENED/AVOID remains historical, not a mandatory Astra output.
leverage.minimum_sell_pattern: A material negative resilience anchor plus sufficiently current/independent evidence that establishes actual severity, persistence or financing/debt-service pressure can support minimum SELL. No mandatory checklist, new numeric cutoff or evidence-count rule.
leverage.new_buyer: WAIT is defensible with unresolved severity/confirmation. Do not impose SELL->AVOID or globally change stance policy.
leverage.positive_symmetry: Low debt and ample cash do not by themselves create minimum BUY. Resilience can corroborate a separate material business/value anchor; do not count cash and debt components twice.
leverage.sell_lean_pattern: High complete debt/thin compatible cash plus stable operating support and unresolved refinancing, maturity and debt-service severity supports the conservative 5.5 negative lean. Missing details limit strength, never create bullish evidence.
leverage.support: Complete interest-bearing debt and cash are contemporaneous, no prior comparison. Narrative risk restates these same economics. Stable operating profit is an offset. Conditional refinancing expectation is not confirmed financing stress.
leverage.thesis_change: UNCHANGED is defensible; WEAKENED requires supplied baseline-relative deterioration, not absolute negative balance-sheet state.

leverage_fixtures.pattern: complete high debt + thin cash + stable operating profit + refinancing/maturity unknown
same leverage plus confirmed refinancing or debt-service stress
high debt with strong compatible liquidity and stable operations
low debt and ample cash without distinct business/value support
